items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I heard Coleman Hawkins, and I said, 'Oh, I've got to play the tenor,' and so I got myself a tenor.

ctx.x: First I got an alto, and I fiddled around with that, and then I heard Coleman Hawkins, and I said, "Oh, I've got to play the tenor," and so I got myself a tenor.

And I stayed with the tenor for quite a number of years after that. In fact I used the tenor right on up, oh, until recent years, when I decided that I'd better just confine myself to alto and soprano.
